text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
And then, I heard footsteps, so when I looked outside my room...
someone was running down the dorm hallway!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I saw that too!
It was in the middle of the night, so it scared me so much~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us more about that?
Could you tell us the details on that, please?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A mysterious shadow wandering around the Miho Dorm in the middle of the night...
As the dorm head, I can't just let that slide.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Indeed! As a member of the Disciplinary Committee, I shall assist in maintaining public order!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: If the rumors hold true, the subject should be moving shortly. I hope this stakeout bears fruit, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Shh, quiet! Those footsteps—
Are they heading towards the dorm entrance...?!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Let us pursue them at once!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hm, nobody is here? 
I was certain they came this way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Over there! Someone's running toward the school building—
Hold on, you're not getting away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... How long are they gonna keep running? 
Leading us all over the place, are they messing with us?!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It matches the witness accounts. 
The culprit is said to be truly elusive, appearing and vanishing like a phantom.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, vanishing like smoke, passing through walls... 
That sounds just like a gho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Rattle-clatter-crash!*)

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!!? 
Th-That noise came from the storage shed...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure the culprit is hiding in there! 
Th-Th-This time for sure, we'll catch 'em!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No way, nobody's here either...
Don't tell me it really is a ghost...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(Damn it, I'm getting the chills...!
If it were a real person, I wouldn't be scared at all—)

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text:
Hate... Resentment...
Curse you all...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!!? 
Stop it, stay away... Uwaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
(You can't have a one-on-one duel with a ghost...
That's why I can't handle them!)

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: *Ch-ch-ch-chatter-rattle-tremble...!*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
!? H-Hey, whoa!? 
Are you alright?! You're shaking like a leaf...!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is... the vibration of my phone! 
This officer remains completely composed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phenomeno...
...Ngh—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
D... Don't worry! 
Protecting the dorm members is the dorm head's job!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Even if a ghost really shows up... 
Big Sis Hishi will beat it to a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Creeeeak-rattle-slam—!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha— The door moved on its own...!
Still trying to mess with me?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hold right there! Let me get a look at that mug of yours! 
Uwooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HEY, YOUUUU!!!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, Dorm Head...?! 
S-Sorry, I'm heading back to the dorm right away!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Halt— Ngh, she's fast! 
However, I have visually confirmed the suspect's face!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that just now... was a girl from our dorm. 
So in other words, it was just someone breaking curfew...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking down the hallway, I spotted Hishi Amazon lecturing a junior dorm student.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Found you at last! 
You broke dorm curfew and were in the school building last night, weren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 
...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Just as I requested beforehand, I stayed overnight elsewhere yesterday, so I wasn't at the academy...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, come to think of it—I did approve that form. 
Which means... wait, huh?
choice_data_list: You look pale, are you alright?
You look pale, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I-I'm fine. 
I'm sure I just mistook someone else for her, yeah...
